summary: Lifeloc Technologies, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a $500,000 secured promissory note from its CFO and Chairman Vern Kornelsen. The funds support continued development of its SpinDetect product. The note carries a 10.5% initial interest rate, interest-only through December 2026, then 60 equal monthly payments with final maturity December 31, 2031. It is secured by a deed of trust on company property and a subordinate security interest in substantially all assets. This is a routine financing agreement, not a special situation. There are no transaction terms, premium, or event-driven risk-arb angle.
